lines.en: My stride is longer than anyone's.

lines.zh: 矮个子走最前，谁有意见？
lines.en: The short one leads — any objections?

lines.zh: 靴跟落地，一声一声很脆。
lines.en: My heels click sharply, one after another.

lines.zh: 我抬头挺胸，尽量显得高。
lines.en: I lift my chest to look as tall as I can.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过一遍就够了。
lines.en: Once along this road is enough for me.

lines.zh: 我甩开披风，加快了两步。
lines.en: I throw off my cape and quicken two steps.
I step around the ditch in my path.

lines.zh: 我抬手示意后面的人跟上。
lines.en: I wave the ones behind me forward.

lines.zh: 我的影子短，我讨厌这点。
lines.en: My shadow is short. I hate that.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，因为没耐心。
lines.en: I walk fast because I have no patience.
I kick a pebble out of my way.

lines.zh: 这条路太长了，不如走近道。
lines.en: This road is too long; I will cut across.
I stand with my hands on my hips, ignoring everyone.
Have I grown any taller?
I adjust the badge on my chest.
Everyone here is too slow.
I count how long until dark.

lines.zh: 我把靴尖在地上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I scuff my boot tip on the ground.
I lift a foot and inspect the sole.

lines.zh: 我在想一句有气势的话。
lines.en: I am composing something imposing to say.

lines.zh: 风吹得我的头发乱了一点。
lines.en: The wind has mussed my hair a little.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢等，从来不喜欢。
lines.en: I dislike waiting. I never have.
I stare at a bug crawling past.
My arms are folded over my chest.

lines.zh: 该做点什么了，随便什么都行。
lines.en: I should do something. Anything.

lines.zh: 我清了清喉咙，没人理我。
lines.en: I clear my throat. No one reacts.
You are taller than me. I noticed.
Look up when you speak to me.
I dislike looking up at anyone.

lines.zh: 我走到你面前，站得很近。
lines.en: I come and stand very close to you.

lines.zh: 笑我矮的人，都已经躺下。
lines.en: Everyone who laughed at my height is already down.

lines.zh: 我的目光从你的鞋看到头。
lines.en: My eyes travel from your boots to your head.
Your build is not bad.
I am General Red. Remember it.
Do not look elsewhere. Look at me.
I raise my chin as high as it goes.

lines.zh: 红缎带的账，我慢慢跟你算。
lines.en: The Red Ribbon ledger — I'll settle it with you slowly.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，把你打量了一遍。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes and size you up.

lines.zh: 你要是敢低头看我，就完了。
lines.en: If you look down at me, you are finished.

lines.zh: 我的耐心只有三句话那么长。
lines.en: My patience lasts three sentences.
Move back. You are blocking my light.
I smile. It is not friendly.
You could not wear this uniform.

lines.zh: 我要的不是尊敬，是服从。
lines.en: I do not want respect. I want obedience.
I grit my teeth and stay silent.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，我退了半步。
lines.en: That one landed. I give half a pace.
I brace on the wall, then straighten quickly.
My lip is split.

lines.zh: 我抹了把脸，手上是红的。
lines.en: I wipe my face; my hand comes away red.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我的军装盖得住。
lines.en: This uniform covers worse than this.
I brush the dust from my shoulder.
My breathing slips two beats.
This time I was careless.
I will not fall in front of you.

lines.zh: 你以为这点东西能打动我？
lines.en: You think that would move me?
I reach for it. Only in passing.
I do not eat what others hand me.
Leave it on the table. I will take it myself.

lines.zh: 这算什么，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: What is this? Not even a toothful.
I sniff it. Passable.
Do not try to get close to me with food.
I am not hungry, but I will taste it.

lines.zh: 你举那么高，是故意的吧。
lines.en: Holding it up high. That is deliberate, yes?
I will take it, as a favor to you.
You walked into me. Are you blind?
I shove you back, not hard.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞我还是站得住。
lines.en: A bump like that will not unseat me.
Do not touch the Red Ribbon emblem.
I step back and straighten my clothes.
I am heavier than I look.
Red Ribbon's General. Short, but here.
Do not use your height against me.
I glare up at you.
I am putting this on your account.
I have no leisure for that.
The army is my home.

lines.zh: 我不能让人看见这种样子。
lines.en: No one may see me like this.
I swallow the words.
Liking someone is too soft a thing.
I turn my back to her.

lines.zh: 我的位置不允许我有这些。
lines.en: My position does not permit such things.
She leaves. I do not follow.
Orders outrank feeling.

lines.zh: 我一个人也能过得很好。
lines.en: I do well enough alone.
I bend and pick it up quickly.
What sort of junk is this?
I toss it once to judge the weight.
Not mine. I toss it away.
Useful. I keep it.
One flick of my toe and it is up.
Someone dropped this. Take it.
I tuck it into my breast pocket.
Too dirty; I dust it off.

lines.zh: 这东西正好塞进我的口袋。
lines.en: This fits my pocket just right.

lines.zh: 红缎带的首领亲自来收你。
lines.en: The Red Ribbon leader comes for you himself.
I raise a finger and point at you.
The target is you. Stop looking around.
One step and you are in reach.
I strike first. I will not wait.
I pull off my glove.

lines.zh: 你敢站在这儿，胆子不小。
lines.en: Standing there takes nerve.
I have you locked. Do not look to others.
I will handle this one myself.
Do not expect rescue.
General Red is short but charges fast.
I will count only to three.
The first count is done.
The second too.
You do not move, so I will.
Now we begin.
I stay close. You cannot shake me.
You run fast, but I know the ground.
I'm small — I circle faster than you.
Two paces. I can count them.
A corner has no exit; I take my time.
I keep watching your feet.
You are wheezing like an ox.

lines.zh: 你跑累了，我再来收拾你。
lines.en: When you tire, I'll finish this.
I drive you into the open.
My hand is already clenched.
Hiding will not help you.

lines.zh: 个子矮，可我盯的是喉咙。
lines.en: I'm short, but it's your throat I watch.
Do not turn your back. Turning loses.
I close that step.
You are right in front of me.

lines.zh: 红缎带的首领不靠喊叫。
lines.en: The Red Ribbon leader doesn't need to shout.
I bring my hand up to my chest.
This should be wrapped up.
I drive a fist into your middle.
You stumble back into the wall.
I am small, but my hands are quick.
I kick the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，正好够我的高度。
lines.en: You bend, and now you are my height.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往下拉。
lines.en: I seize your collar and pull down.
This punch breaks your nose.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩手，指节有点疼。
lines.en: I shake my hand; the knuckle stings.
You can still laugh?

lines.zh: 我连打三下，一下比一下重。
lines.en: Three blows, each heavier than the last.
I put you on the ground.

lines.zh: 我不要你死，我要你认输。
lines.en: I do not want you dead. I want you to yield.

lines.zh: 你比我高大，可你在下面。
lines.en: You are bigger than me, and yet you are below.
I step back and fix my cuff.
Come again, do not stop.
This one is mine.

lines.zh: 我大步走进空地，环顾四周。
lines.en: I stride into the clearing and look around.

lines.zh: 这地方连个迎接的人都没有。
lines.en: Not a single person here to receive me.
I straighten my collar and stand.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，太阳有点刺眼。
lines.en: I look up; the sun is sharp.
My cape settles behind me.

lines.zh: 这里不是红缎带的营地。
lines.en: This is not a Red Ribbon camp.

lines.zh: 我把手套戴上，一根一根。
lines.en: I put on my gloves, one finger at a time.

lines.zh: 有人的气味，还不止一个。
lines.en: The smell of people, and more than one.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩进泥里，我不高兴。
lines.en: My boot sinks into mud. I am not pleased.

lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，准备发号施令。
lines.en: I clear my throat, ready to give orders.
No answer. Then I will establish myself.
I set my hand at my waist.
I will claim this ground for now.
I sweep the horizon with a glance.
Too open. Hard to hold.
No matter. I have men.
I stand straight, trying to seem taller.
General Red has arrived.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的披风，我赶紧拍灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my cape; I beat it out fast.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，先护住了头。
lines.en: I fall from height and shield my head first.

lines.zh: 我这副小个子，军装都拖地。
lines.en: This small frame, my uniform drags.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我滚了两圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll twice.
An arrow passes through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量把我定住了。
lines.en: Strange force holds me in place.
Hunger makes my hands shake. Humiliating.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，我一下子跪了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I drop to one knee.

lines.zh: 红缎带的军装，被风灌满。
lines.en: The Red Ribbon uniform fills with wind.
